posts.post:
the guy who dry cleans his raw denim vs the guy who hasn't washed his in a year.

who is actually getting it right?

getting out of bed on a Sunday, throwing on a worn-in sweatshirt, and not seeing a single person all day.

that's peak clothing performance.
there is no greater fashion disaster than a dress shirt collar that loses its shape under a light sweater.

we finally got the dye batch perfect on the charcoal shade.

three factories told us it wasn't possible. they were wrong.
